added: Sign in with your anotoki account on the website, piano.anotoki.eu - your progress is saved to your account and waits for you on any computer
On your own computer the app still needs no sign-in, and a setup page asks for the database the first time
A light and a dark look - press the theme button at the bottom of the page to choose, or let your computer decide
The app works on phones and small screens too
This list of what is new: press the version number at the bottom of the page
updated: The whole app has been rebuilt from the ground up - the same lessons, Note Trainer, Sheet Practice, Songs and Stats, on a new base that is ready for the left hand, both hands and chords
Your progress is kept in a database instead of files - everything you practised before is still there
If a save does not get through (no internet, the server is away), the app says "Not saved yet" and keeps trying, and a finished round waits in your browser until it arrives
The note you should play now is coloured on the staff, not only its stem
